missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Специалист' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the predicate. 'Опытный' is the agreeing masculine adjective describing experience.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Специалиста' takes the animate masculine accusative, which matches the genitive form. 'Хорошего' agrees in the same case.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Специалиста' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that the specialist is lacking. 'В отделе' is the prepositional location.

missions.phrase: Я обратился к специалисту за помощью.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Специалисту' is the dative form after 'к', marking the person approached. 'За помощью' explains the purpose.
Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate. 'Специалистом' is the instrumental form after 'стал', a common pattern for becoming something. 'Известным' agrees in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Специалисте' takes the prepositional form after 'в' to express confidence in the person. 'Этом' agrees, and 'уверен' completes the idea.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Специалиста' is the genitive form showing whose opinion it is. 'Мнение' is the nominative subject described by 'важно'.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Специалиста' is genitive singular required by 'три'. 'В команде' is the prepositional location of work.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Специалистов' takes the animate accusative plural, matching the genitive plural. 'Молодых' agrees in the same case.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after мало. 'Специалистов' is the genitive plural required by 'мало'. 'Хороших' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в городе' is locational.
